tool_signatures.description: Compare Case-Shiller home price indices across multiple US metros in one call (the 20-city composite). Use for "which metros are softening", "Case-Shiller for [list of cities]", "compare housing prices in X, Y, Z" queries — picks the right per-metro FRED series IDs (DNXRSA, PHXRSA, TPXRSA, etc.) so callers don't have to. tool_signatures.name: get_competition_matches

competition.description: Competition code (e.g., "PL" = Premier League, "PD" = La Liga, "CL" = Champions League)

tool_signatures.name: get_competition_standings
tool_signatures.description: League table for a competition season. Returns total / home / away tables.

matchday.description: Standings as of a specific matchday (optional)

tool_signatures.name: get_compound
tool_signatures.description: Get standard properties for a PubChem CID: molecular formula, molecular weight, IUPAC name, canonical SMILES, isomeric SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, exact mass, charge, complexity, H-bond donors/acceptors, rotatable bonds, TPSA, XLogP, heavy atom count.

tool_signatures.name: get_concept
tool_signatures.description: Look up research fields or topics by name. Returns concept description, publication count, related concepts, and parent concepts in the academic hierarchy.

query.description: Concept name to look up (e.g., "deep learning")

tool_signatures.name: get_connection_config
tool_signatures.description: Get MCP setup instructions for connecting to Pipeworx packs. Returns connection details and gateway URLs. Use to configure your environment.

slugs.description: Comma-separated pack slugs (e.g., "weather,github,jokes") or "all" for everything

tool_signatures.name: get_connections

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return. Defaults to 4.

tool_signatures.name: get_contract_abi
tool_signatures.description: Verified contract ABI as JSON (if the contract is verified on Etherscan).

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)

tool_signatures.name: get_contract_source
tool_signatures.description: Verified contract source code, compiler version, optimization settings, and license.

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)

tool_signatures.name: get_country_by_code
tool_signatures.description: Get country details by ISO code (e.g., "US" for United States or "FRA" for France). Returns capital, population, languages, currencies, area, and region.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code

tool_signatures.name: get_country_stats
tool_signatures.description: Check COVID-19 stats for a specific country (e.g., "US", "India", "GB"). Returns cases, deaths, recovered, active cases, today's change, and population.

tool_signatures.name: get_cpi
tool_signatures.description: Get US Consumer Price Index for all urban consumers over time. Returns monthly index values by year and month to track inflation.

tool_signatures.name: get_crate
tool_signatures.description: Get full metadata for a specific crate (e.g., 'serde'). Returns description, downloads, latest version, repo, homepage, and categories.

tool_signatures.name: get_crew
tool_signatures.description: List SpaceX crew members. Returns name, agency, status, wikipedia link, and image URL for each crew member.

tool_signatures.name: get_crimes
tool_signatures.description: Get street-level crimes near a latitude/longitude for a given month. Returns crime category, location, and outcome status.

date.description: Month to query in YYYY-MM format (e.g. "2024-01"). Defaults to latest available.

tool_signatures.name: get_crypto_market
tool_signatures.description: Get top cryptocurrencies ranked by market cap. Returns rank, name, symbol, USD price, market cap, 24h volume, and 24h % change for each.

limit.description: Number of coins to return (1-100, default 10)

tool_signatures.name: get_crypto_price
tool_signatures.description: Get current price, market cap, 24h change, and 24h high/low for a cryptocurrency. Accepts common names ("bitcoin", "ethereum", "solana"), tickers ("BTC", "ETH"), or coinpaprika IDs ("btc-bitcoin"). Powered by coinpaprika (keyless).

coin_id.description: Coin name, ticker, or coinpaprika ID (e.g., "bitcoin", "BTC", "btc-bitcoin")

tool_signatures.name: get_csv_download_url
tool_signatures.description: Return the StatCan-hosted URL for the full cube as a CSV download. Doesn't fetch the file — gives a direct URL agents can hand to a downloader.

tool_signatures.name: get_cube_metadata
tool_signatures.description: Fetch full metadata for a cube: dimensions, member trees (e.g., "Goods-producing industries", "Services-producing industries"), frequency, geography, last release. Use to figure out a coordinate string for get_latest_data.

product_id.description: Cube product ID (8-digit, e.g., 36100434 = quarterly GDP)

tool_signatures.name: get_currencies
tool_signatures.description: List all supported currencies with codes and full names. Use to verify currency codes before converting or checking rates.

tool_signatures.name: get_current
tool_signatures.description: Get current instantaneous streamflow (discharge, cfs) and gage height (ft) for a USGS monitoring site.

site_id.description: USGS site number (e.g., "01646500" for Potomac River at Little Falls, MD)

tool_signatures.name: get_current_standings
tool_signatures.description: Check current F1 driver championship standings. Returns position, points, wins, driver name, and constructor for all drivers.

tool_signatures.name: get_current_waves
tool_signatures.description: Check real-time wave conditions at a coastal location. Returns current wave height, period, and direction. Use for immediate surfing, boating, or maritime planning decisions.

tool_signatures.name: get_cve
tool_signatures.description: Get full details for a specific CVE (e.g., "CVE-2021-44228"). Returns description, severity, CVSS score, affected products, and remediation info. Use when you need comprehensive vulnerability analysis.

tool_signatures.name: get_daily
tool_signatures.description: Get daily mean streamflow values for a USGS site over a date range. Dates must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tool_signatures.name: get_daily_history
tool_signatures.description: Daily historical weather for a Meteostat station between two dates. Returns date-keyed temperature (avg/min/max), precipitation, snow, wind, pressure, sun hours. Station IDs are numeric — find them at meteostat.net (URL suffix).

tool_signatures.name: get_datasets
tool_signatures.description: List all available IMF databases/datasets. Returns database IDs and names you can use with get_data and search_indicators. Example: call with no arguments to browse available datasets like IFS (International Financial Statistics), BOP (Balance of Payments), etc.

tool_signatures.name: get_deaths
tool_signatures.description: Find notable people who died on a specific date. Provide month (1-12) and day (1-31). Returns names, death years, and biographical detail.

tool_signatures.name: get_departments
tool_signatures.description: List all departments in the Met collection (e.g., "Paintings", "Sculpture", "Photographs"). Use department names to filter search_artworks results.

tool_signatures.name: get_departures

begin.description: Start of time range as Unix timestamp (seconds)

tool_signatures.name: get_dependencies

tool_signatures.name: get_deputy
tool_signatures.description: Deputy profile by slug or numeric id.

tool_signatures.name: get_docket

tool_signatures.name: get_doi

tool_signatures.name: get_downloads
tool_signatures.description: Check download counts for a package over a time period (e.g., 'last-week', 'last-month', 'last-year'). Returns total downloads to assess package popularity and adoption.

tool_signatures.name: get_driver

tool_signatures.name: get_drucksache
tool_signatures.description: Drucksache (printed document) detail by id.

tool_signatures.name: get_drug
tool_signatures.description: Full SPL metadata + sections (e.g. dosage, warnings) by set_id.

tool_signatures.name: get_earnings_calendar
tool_signatures.description: Get upcoming and recent earnings reports across the market. Optionally filter by date range. Example: get_earnings_calendar({ from: "2024-01-01", to: "2024-03-31", _apiKey: "your-key" })

tool_signatures.name: get_earthquakes
tool_signatures.description: Search recent earthquakes by location and magnitude threshold. Returns magnitude, depth, coordinates, and timestamp for each event.

tool_signatures.name: get_elevation
tool_signatures.description: Elevation in metres above mean sea level for a single lat/lon.

tool_signatures.name: get_elevations
tool_signatures.description: Batch elevation lookup. Pass an array of {latitude, longitude} points (up to 1,000 per call recommended). Returns each with elevation in metres.

tool_signatures.name: get_employment_by_industry
tool_signatures.description: Get US non-farm payroll employment by industry (manufacturing, construction, retail, financial, government, etc.). Returns employment figures in thousands by period.

tool_signatures.name: get_enterprise

tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information for a specific exercise by its numeric ID.

tool_signatures.name: patents_search_patents
tool_signatures.description: Search USPTO patent applications and grants. Use `query` for free-text keywords ("lithium battery", "crispr"). Optional structured filters: `applicant` (company name — use ALL CAPS like "APPLE INC." for best match), `filed_after` / `filed_before` (filing date range), `granted_after` / `granted_before` (grant date range). Results include title, application number, filing date, first applicant, all applicants, inventors, status, classification. Note: ODP filtering is approximate (weighted match, not strict equality) — counts and ordering are best-effort. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

query.description: Free-text search across title/abstract/inventor/etc. Examples: "lithium battery", "crispr", "neural network". Pass "*" if you only want to filter by applicant/date with no keyword constraint.

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key. Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/myodp. Falls back to platform key if configured.

applicant.description: Optional. Company applicant name as it appears on the USPTO filing. **Must include the exact corporate suffix** the company uses (PBC / Inc. / LLC / Corporation / Co. / NV / AG / KK). Wrong suffix = ODP silently returns the whole unfiltered pool, not zero. Examples: "Anthropic, PBC" (not "Anthropic Inc."), "Apple Inc." (not "Apple"), "Alphabet Inc." (not "Google"), "Meta Platforms, Inc." (not "Facebook"), "Microsoft Corporation" (not "Microsoft Corp."). If you get a `warning` field back, the filter missed — retry with a different corporate form.

filed_after.description: Optional. Filter to patents filed on/after this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

filed_before.description: Optional. Filter to patents filed on/before this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

granted_after.description: Optional. Filter to patents granted on/after this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

granted_before.description: Optional. Filter to patents granted on/before this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

video_id.description: Video ID or comma-separated list of video IDs (max 50)

tool_signatures.name: zillow_home_values
tool_signatures.description: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI) — monthly home value estimates as a time series. Returns observation_date + value pairs for the matching region (case-insensitive substring match on region name). Coverage: US metros, states, national.

region.description: Region name, e.g. "Los Angeles", "California", "United States". Substring match.

tool_signatures.name: zillow_market_snapshot
tool_signatures.description: Latest available value across every metric (home value, rent, inventory, sales count, median sale price, new listings) for a single region. Useful for a one-call "tell me everything about this market" view.

tool_signatures.name: zillow_rent_prices
tool_signatures.description: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI) — monthly rent estimates as a time series. US metros only. Returns observation_date + value pairs.

tool_signatures.name: zillow_top_markets
tool_signatures.description: Ranked list of regions by latest value of a metric. metric=zhvi region_type=metro direction=top → most expensive metros. direction=bottom → cheapest. Returns up to 100 rows.

metric.description: One of: zhvi | zori | sales_count | median_sale_price | inventory | new_listings

tool_signatures.name: zoho_list_records
tool_signatures.description: List records from a Zoho CRM module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals).

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return (e.g., "Last_Name,Email,Phone"). Defaults to common fields.

module.description: Module name (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts)
